what.text: This page follows refugees from Syria living in Hungary, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 175 Syrian refugees in Hungary, 0.0% of all refugees from Syria.
Türkiye hosts the most Syrian refugees, followed by Germany, Lebanon and Jordan.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Syria in every year from 2011 to 2025, at war level in most of them.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Syria from 2013 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 8 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 971, at the end of 2018; the main years of displacement in the data are 2016 to 2024.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Hungary.
These are year-end totals for Hungary only, reported to UNHCR.
